The template's generated Cargo.toml has [build-dependencies] and its ww_firmware_info line twice (generator bug, not taken). Hardware test: see CHANGELOG API-9.

nuances: src/main.rs is hand-written (64 MHz PLL clock tree, assign-resources, spawned adc/button tasks): never replace it with the template's, only port individual changes (e.g. counter macros in DefaultHandler/HardFault) by hand
embassy-stm32 uses time-driver-tim4 on purpose: time-driver-any picks TIM15, which drives the PF1 LED. Keep it when Cargo.toml template changes
Local Cargo.toml additions to keep: embassy-usb, embassy-futures, [features] debug-adc/debug-button, [[bin]] test=false, defmt-rtt disable-blocking-mode
src/adc.rs, button.rs, led.rs, examples/, scripts/size.py are local-only (not from the template), but they use the cnt macros, so update them together with template counter-syntax changes

WireWeaver layout differs from the template's: the API crate is donguru_api/ in the repo root (two levels up, in the root workspace, uses workspace edition/license), the firmware is fw/donguru/ (not firmware/). When regenerating with --wire-weaver, map <out>/donguru_api -> ../../donguru_api and <out>/firmware -> . ; the generator writes absolute --ww-src paths, keep the relative ../../../wire_weaver (firmware) and ../../wire_weaver (API crate) paths

USB is set up in main.rs (UsbResources, Irqs, usb::Driver::new) and passed to ww::start; ww.rs has no bind_interrupts/usb_driver. ServerState owns no LED: PF1 is the PWM status LED owned by led::led_task, the API calls led::set
embassy-usb is a direct dependency with default-features = false (also used by examples/usb_serial.rs); wire_weaver_usb_embassy pulls its own features

ww.rs follows the local wire_weaver checkout API from 3f1ccf8 'feat(server): pass a request context to every handler' (WireWeaverAsyncApiBackend::Medium, process_bytes(out: &mut EventWriter, medium, ...), handlers take &mut Context<'_, impl EventOut>), newer than the template's (f10b345) ww.rs; when taking template ww.rs changes, keep the signatures matching the checkout

src/ww.rs is split into src/ww/ (API-8, donguru_api 0.2): mod.rs has what came from the template's ww.rs (ww_codegen!, WireWeaverAsyncApiBackend, USB composite setup with fixed endpoint addresses EP1/EP2 WireWeaver and EP3 CMSIS-DAP, server task with observe polling); one handler module per level of the API tree (device.rs, plug.rs, ...) is this firmware's own. Template ww.rs changes go to ww/mod.rs; ServerState is no longer passed to ww::start (a static inside ww)

Crash capture (bedrock_crash): the record is in cortex-m-rt's .uninit; nothing in this firmware initialises RAM by hand, keep it that way. ww::start takes the last_reset Snapshot; ServerState lives in a static inside ww
